name: TestFontRoboto

source.verification: Release asset of googlefonts/roboto-3-classic v3.016 (2026-06-17); its SHA-256 matches the GitHub release asset digest. hinted/static/Roboto-Regular.ttf was extracted byte for byte from the archive. The archive has no license file, so OFL.txt was taken from the same tag (raw.githubusercontent.com/googlefonts/roboto-3-classic/v3.016/OFL.txt).

notes: Fixed test font for the font library and font backend tests (Docs/Design/Font/08-ThirdParty.ko.md section 8.5): tests read the file from the repository and never use fonts installed on the machine. Not shipped in any product.
